critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1058 lines — still recommended to split into routers/ (auth, chapters, admin, library, sr) for maintainability.
KanjiStroke.jsx uses cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/KanjiVG at runtime — no CSP/hosting fallback if CDN blocked; consider self-hosting or preloading key kanji SVGs.

AuthPage.jsx `reset()` renders whatever `r.data.message` is inside temporary-box (data-testid forgot-password-notice) — safe because backend now returns only the generic string; ensure future backend changes never re-add sensitive fields.

Admin.jsx ResetUserPassword displays the temp password in plain text on screen — acceptable per spec (admin gives it to user privately), but consider adding a copy-to-clipboard button and auto-hide after N seconds.
KanjiVG fetch has no timeout — a slow CDN could keep the card in perpetual 'loading' state; add AbortController with ~5s timeout and set 'fallback' state on timeout.
